rationale: C19 is an exceptionally close drafting predecessor. The child preserves the same single-sentence operative structure, the same Senate committee, the same investigative purpose, the same Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133 compliance mechanism, and the same Federal Register effectiveness clause. Its principal updates are the Congress number, ending tax year, omission of excess-profits returns, and presidential attribution. C08 and C23 are earlier versions of substantially the same recurring template, but C19 is both more recent and textually closer.

shared_material.child_excerpt: any income, estate, or gift tax return for the years 1947 to 1961, inclusive, shall, during the Eighty-seventh Congress, be open to inspection by the Senate Committee on Government Operations, or by any duly authorized subcommittee thereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: any income, excess-profits, estate, or gift tax return for the years 1947 to 1959, inclusive, shall, during the Eighty-sixth Congress, be open to inspection by the Senate Committee on Government Operations, or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof
shared_material.explanation: The same authorization formula is retained with mechanical updates to tax categories, years, and Congress.

shared_material.child_excerpt: in connection with its studies of the operation of Government activities at all levels with a view to determining the economy and efficiency of the Government
shared_material.parent_excerpt: in connection with its studies of the operation of Government activities at all levels with a view to determining the economy and efficiency of the Government
shared_material.explanation: The distinctive statement of investigative purpose is reproduced verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133 relating to the inspection of tax returns by committees of the Congress, approved by the President on May 3, 1955
shared_material.parent_excerpt: such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133, relating to the inspection of returns by committees of the Congress, approved by me on May 3, 1955
shared_material.explanation: The child uses the same specific administrative machinery and approval date, with only minor attribution and wording changes.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This order shall become effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.explanation: The effectiveness clause is nearly identical and completes the same operative sequence.
